text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For this year's Shundai Festival, as an extra measure of devotion, it was decided that a Shirabyoshi dance would be dedicated to pray for safety.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess was chosen
as the dancer, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*...! *gasp*... *pant*...!
Going non-stop since morning is brutal after all, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're hopeless!
Here, have some of my special "Magical Potion"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you so very much~~!!
*gulp* *gulp* *gulp*...!!
Pffhaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Sweep Tosho's cooperation,
Kawakami Princess trained hard day after day.
However—
choice_data_list: Aren't you pushing yourself too hard?
Aren't you overdoing it a little?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew! No need to worry!
This much practice is second nature for a princess!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Stopping her won't do any good. Once Kawakami decides on something,
she sees it through to the bitter end.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My family is coming to watch, after all!
I cannot possibly show them an unsightly performance!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My little brother even packs and brings bento boxes for me!
And besides—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Especially my parents—I've caused them so much worry with my tomboyish antics...

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
VROOOOOOM!!
Brilliant Knuckle~~! (KA-BOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's dangerous!!
Honestly, why is this kid always like this...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried about so many things.
I just hope she learns a little moderation...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I want to see this ritual through and put their minds at ease!
To show them, 'Even if I'm a tomboy, I can do a splendid job'!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"The time for the 'ritual' where everyone shows their fine form will come...
Grandma said it's a witch's duty to support that, too!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll take Kawakami to the "ritual" myself!
You just sit back and watch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To Kawakami Princess, this ritual was likely a rite of passage marking her growth. Perhaps as an adult, I should just watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
—All right! I'm gonna give it everything I've got, just you watch~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then came the day of the sacred ritual.
The venue was bustling with a large crowd of spectators."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!
Kawakami came out!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(...I was a tomboy, always restless.
I was always making Mother and the others worry...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure you came here today
with your heart in your throat, didn't you?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, please watch over me.
Watch the dance that carries all of my feelings—)

text_block_list.name: Shinto Prayer
text_block_list.text:
Before you stands a shirabyoshi dancer of fleeting life.
Through this dedicatory dance, I humbly present my deepest prayer.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Prayer
text_block_list.text:
I humbly pray unto the deities: cleanse and purify
all misfortunes and calamities, and with utmost reverence,
I beseech thee to hear my prayer.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—S-So beautiful...!
—Is that really Kawakami Princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~... I was so nervous...
Did I manage to dance properly...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well, wasn't that pretty good? I, the genius magical girl Sweepy, will give it my official seal of approval!♪
choice_data_list: I'm sure your feelings reached your family.
I'm sure your feelings reached your family.
I couldn't take my eyes off you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well, wasn't that pretty good? I, the genius magical girl Sweepy, will give it my official seal of approval!♪
choice_data_list: I'm sure your feelings reached your family.
I'm sure your feelings reached your family.
I couldn't take my eyes off you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! Surely that must be so!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...! Ah, there you are!
I've been looking all over the venue for you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Everyone...!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Father
text_block_list.text: I was surprised. You, who were always such a tomboy... danced so... gracefully and magnificently...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Mother
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes! You really... worked so hard, and did so wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
Listen! Sis...
You looked so, so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...!
I-If you say something like that, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez... If you start crying too, things are just gonna get totally out of hand.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Becauuuse, becauuuse, hic, waaaahh...!
I-I'm just so happy~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! Surely that must be so!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just a moment!
I have a LANE message from Mother.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! Everyone was watching me!
My dance! Right there at the venue!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-You said... I was 'magnificent'...
Uguuu~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! A great magician personally lent you a hand, after all.
Hold your head up higher with pride!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: *sniff*! ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! Surely that must be so!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just a moment!
I have a LANE message from Mother.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ngh!! Nuuuungwaaaahhh~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Everyone came to the venue, but apparently they couldn't see anything through the crowd...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, good grief............

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "I thought that might happen, so I cast an 'Unforgettable Magic' on you beforehand. Behold, Statice☆Refrain!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Look, I recorded it right here.
There's no room for oversight when
supporting a genius magical girl, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san...!!
I'm so ridiculously grateful to you~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, having received the video,
Kawakami Princess sent the footage of her
heroic display to her family.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Trainer, stop it!
You're such a flatterer~~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still, hearing you say that... hehe!
It makes me very happy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why are you two drifting off into your own little world!
If you don't look for your family, they're gonna head home without you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-hoh!
We must catch them before they head home, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Could you two lend a hand?
With the three of us together, we'll have a million horsepower!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll use my person-finding magic!
I'll find them in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Well then, let's go~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The three of us pushed our way through the crowd to search for Kawakami Princess's family.
